{{Short description|none}}
The '''2025 Copa Libertadores group stage''' was played from 1 April to 29 May 2025.<ref name="fixture">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Fixture_Fase-de-Grupos_CONMEBOL-Libertadores-2025_18.3.2025.pdf|title=CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2025 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - FASE DE GRUPOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión 18.03.2025|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=18 March 2025|access-date=18 March 2025}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the group stage to decide the 16 places in the [[2025 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]] of the [[2025 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CL-2025-ESP-Digital.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes CONMEBOL Libertadores 2025|trans-title=2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores Clubs Handbook|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=12 December 2024|access-date=16 December 2024}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw /><noinclude>
The draw for the group stage was held on 17 March 2025, 20:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], Paraguay.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/fase-de-grupos-confirmada-en-la-gloria-eterna/|title=¡Fase de Grupos confirmada en La Gloria Eterna!|trans-title=Group Stage confirmed in The Eternal Glory!|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=17 March 2025|access-date=17 March 2025}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 16 December 2024 (shown in parentheses),<ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Ranking-CONMEBOL-2025-Final-2.pdf|title=Ranking de Clubes de la CONMEBOL 2025|trans-title=2025 CONMEBOL Clubs Ranking|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=16 December 2024|access-date=16 December 2024|language=es}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=2 February 2021|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210830090237/https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|archive-date=30 August 2021}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2015–2024.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2014 and 2002–2014 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.
</noinclude>
For the group stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups (Groups A–H) of four containing a team from each of the four pots. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group, excluding the four winners of the third stage, which were allocated to Pot 4 and could be drawn into the same group with another team from the same association.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/pautas-de-sorteo-de-fase-de-grupos-para-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Pautas de sorteo de Fase de Grupos para la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|trans-title=Group Stage draw guidelines for the 2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=7 March 2025|access-date=13 March 2025}}</ref>

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the group stage, each group was played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. Teams were ranked according to the following criteria: 1. [[Points (association football)|Points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss); 2. [[Goal difference]]; 3. Goals scored; 4. Away goals scored; 5. CONMEBOL ranking (Regulations Article 2.4.2).<ref name="regulations"/>

The winners and runners-up of each group advanced to the [[2025 Copa Libertadores final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2025 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]]. The third-placed teams of each group entered the [[2025 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Knockout round play-offs|knockout round play-offs]] of the [[2025 Copa Sudamericana]].<section end=Format />
